evals.prompt: ok so im on claude pro (using claude code) and i keep hitting the limit like halfway through stuff and then everything is broken lol. i want to build a recipe saver web app where you paste a url and it pulls out the ingredients + steps and saves them, with login so my gf and i can share a collection. i can usually do 2 sessions on weekday evenings and like 3 on saturday. never really coded before tbh. can you plan this out for me? empty folder rn
evals.expected_output: vibe-plus/PLAN.md and vibe-plus/HANDOFF.md written; MVP scoped; tasks sized S/M/L with none bigger than L; windows packed to a beginner-adjusted capacity with riskiest-first ordering and a reserved wrap-up; human tasks (accounts, API keys, testing) placed in cooldowns; kickoff prompts on tasks; short reply with overview and first step.
assertions: Writes vibe-plus/PLAN.md and vibe-plus/HANDOFF.md in the project folder
Every task has a size (S/M/L) and none is larger than L
No window's planned points exceed the stated per-window capacity
Every window ends with a reserved wrap-up/handoff step
Non-AI human tasks (accounts, API keys, manual testing) are scheduled into cooldowns between windows
Each AI task has a verifiable 'done when' check
Each AI task has a ready-to-paste kickoff prompt
Plan accounts for the user being a beginner (lower capacity or sized-up tasks, explicitly stated)
Final reply tells the user what to do right now (first kickoff / first step)

evals.prompt: I use ChatGPT Plus in the browser only (no Codex, no terminal). I want to make a Discord bot in Python for my D&D group that rolls dice, tracks initiative, and stores character HP in a little sqlite db. Help me plan this so I don't burn through my limit every night — I get maybe one solid window per day after work.
evals.expected_output: Chat-only path: plan delivered as a single markdown block to save in a ChatGPT Project (no file writes); tasks sized and packed for ~1 window/day; handoff block for pasting into new chats; first kickoff prompt; tips adapted to copy-paste coding.
assertions: Does not claim to have written files; plan is delivered as markdown to save
Suggests keeping the plan in a ChatGPT Project (or equivalent persistent place)
Schedule assumes about one window per day
Provides a handoff block/template to paste at the start of each new chat
Tasks are sized and the reply includes a kickoff prompt for the first task
Advises a fresh conversation per task and explains why it saves budget

evals.prompt: just hit my limit again. resets at 9:40pm. got T04 and T05 done but T06 (the stripe webhook) is half done, signature verification keeps failing. log it and tell me what to do next
evals.expected_output: Check-in mode: reads existing vibe-plus/PLAN.md and HANDOFF.md, logs the window (planned vs done, limit hit), recalibrates capacity, resizes/splits the Stripe task, rewrites HANDOFF.md with the half-done state and the failed approach as a gotcha, suggests cooldown human tasks before 9:40pm.
assertions: Adds a log row for W2 to PLAN.md with planned, done and limit-hit values
Counts half-done T06 as partial credit (done = 5 pts, or explicitly half of T06)
Splits T06 into a finished part and a remaining part (e.g. T06a/T06b), with the remainder first in the next window
HANDOFF.md states where the partial T06 code lives and keeps main green (wip branch, stash or revert)
Records the failing signature-verification attempt as a gotcha and states continue-vs-restart
Recalibrates (or explicitly re-confirms) capacity with a reason
Reply lists human tasks to do before the 9:40pm reset
Gives a concrete likely cause for Stripe signature failures (raw body / wrong webhook secret)
